Mindflayers

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Mindflayers

A mindflayer known as Hush tried to redesign Rogdag’s brain in an attempt to discover a trigger or seed for psychic ability. Instead, his experiments altered the ogre’s perception of time. Rogdag could not only see future possibilities, but he also emitted a field that affected others when they were in a receptive state.
